mapper.select:
SELECT A.indexNo, A.FINPROD_ID, A.remainPrinAmt, A.reduceAmt, A.CUSTOM_LEVEL, A.AMT_MIN, A.AMT_MAX, A.TERM_MAX, A.TERM_MIN, to_char(A.vDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, to_char(A.mDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, A.interest FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN T1.OPERATION_TYPE = '01' then to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') ELSE t3.BRANCH || '' END indexNo, T1.FINPROD_ID, T3.remainPrinAmt, T3.remainPrinAmt reduceAmt, T3.interest-NVL(t5.intamt,0) interest, nvl(t4.intdate,T1.VDATE) vDate, TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, T2.CUSTOM_LEVEL, T2.AMT_MIN, T2.AMT_MAX, T2.TERM_MAX, T2.TERM_MIN FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT bok.finprod_id, --nvl(f.branch, t.branch) branch, null branch, bok.tdy_prin_amt remainPrinAmt, bok.tdy_unpaid_intincexp interest FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD bok
WHERE bok.cdate = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') -1 day and bok.tdy_prin_amt > 0 and bok.finprod_id = #{finprodId}) T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( select deal.finprod_id,max(settle_date) intdate from trd_product_deal deal where deal.ps = #{C7} and settle_date <=TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (deal.is_cancel ='N' or deal.is_cancel is null) group by deal.finprod_id ) T4 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( select deal.finprod_id,sum(deal.trade_amt) intamt from trd_product_deal deal where deal.ps = #{C7} and deal.settle_date=TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (deal.is_cancel ='N' OR DEAL.IS_CANCEL IS NULL) group by deal.finprod_id )T5 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T1.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) A

SELECT A.indexNo, A.FINPROD_ID, A.remainPrinAmt, A.reduceAmt, A.PROD_STYLE, to_char(A.vDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, to_char(A.mDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, A.interest FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN T1.OPERATION_TYPE = '01' then to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') ELSE t3.BRANCH || '' END indexNo, T1.FINPROD_ID, T3.tdy_prin_amt-nvl(T6.prinAmt,0) remainPrinAmt, T3.tdy_prin_amt-nvl(T6.prinAmt,0) reduceAmt, T3.tdy_unpaid_intincexp - NVL(t5.intamt, 0) /*- NVL(t6.intamt, 0)*/ interest, nvl(t4.intdate, T1.VDATE) vDate, TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, T2.PROD_STYLE FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM T2
ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.Finprod_Id
ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.p_Finprod_Id
LEFT JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRD T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID and T3.cdate = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1 day /*上一个付息交易*/ LEFT JOIN (select deal.finprod_id, max(deal.mdate) intdate from trd_product_deal deal where deal.ps in (#{C7}) and deal.mdate <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (deal.is_cancel = #{NO} or deal.is_cancel is null) group by deal.finprod_id, deal.branch) T4 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID /*减去付息截止日收到的利息*/ LEFT JOIN (select deal.finprod_id, sum(deal.INT_AMT) intamt from trd_product_deal deal where deal.ps in (#{C7}, #{C15}) and ( (deal.ps=#{C15} and deal.settle_date = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) or deal.ps=#{C7} and TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') between deal.mdate and deal.settle_date ) and (deal.is_cancel = #{NO} OR DEAL.IS_CANCEL IS NULL)
and nvl(deal.P_TRADE_ID,'null')='null'
and deal.trade_status =#{tradeStatus}
group by deal.finprod_id) T5 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID /*减去当天已赎回的本金 增加到期本金*/ LEFT JOIN (select deal.finprod_id, sum(deal.PRIN_AMT) prinAmt from trd_product_deal deal
where deal.ps in (#{C4},#{C5}) AND NVL(deal.P_TRADE_ID,'null')='null'
and deal.settle_date = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (deal.is_cancel = #{NO} OR DEAL.IS_CANCEL IS NULL)
and deal.trade_status =#{tradeStatus}
group by deal.finprod_id) T6 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID
WHERE
T1.p_Finprod_Id = #{finprodId}
T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
AND NVL(T3.TDY_PRIN_AMT, 0) != 0 AND T1.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) A
